# They are copied into .reference/ as read-only snapshots and never committed (docs/reference-repos.md).
# Private repos need the secret REFERENCE_REPOS_TOKEN, a token that can only read code.
#

# https://dev.azure.com/<ORG>/<PROJECT>/_git/<REPO> legacy-api
